notes.title: V 1.1.6 patch, fixed blank npc sprites.
notes.content:
Brothers and sisters, recently a kind soul sent a bug report to my email, allowing me to address it. I believe almost everyone has encountered the blank rectangle NPCs at the store, well it's gone for good now. 

I apologize for neglecting the forums; at some point, I simply stopped visiting and completely forgot about the project. So, if you find any more bugs, no matter how small, please email me at earrgames@gmail.com, and I’ll address them as soon as I can.

Thanks for understanding!

notes.title: Patch v1.1.5 (Instant One-Click-Chording)
notes.content:
This patch is aimed to make the game a bit more comfortable. A new menu option was added to activate the potentially dangerous but fast Instant-Click-Chording. (Hovering this option also explains all the ways to chord if you left this option disabled)

Summary:
[list]
[*] Added a One-Click instant chording option to the settings menu (Left or Right clicking a number will auto-chord immediately. Disabled by default)
[*] The Changes-Log box is now scrollable with the mouse wheel.
[*] Windowed mode option converted to single checkbox next to resolution selector.
[*] Blacksmith sprite was slightly modified (Reduced jaw protrusion and edited collarbone color)
[/list]

Anyway... let me know if I broke anything! ːChipWinkː
Emmanuel, (earrgames)

notes.title: Update 1.1.4 is finally here.
notes.content:
Hello, hope you are all doing well!

Just passing by to announce a small patch/bugfix for some of the reports in the bug's thread (Technically not a patch, as the engine was updated too, but oh well...). This took me a bit longer than intended as I had to upgrade the engine version and a lot of things broke down. Hopefully this will extend the game compatibility for the years to come.

PD: I replayed the game, and there are a few things I would like to discuss with you about the design and leaderboards. I didn't want to do drastic changes without getting your opinion first, so I'll soon start a thread in the forums with more information.

Anyhow, the changes for this version:
[list]
[*] Ported from Unity 5 to Unity 2017.
[*] Fixed a score system glitch: The score bonus was carrying over to the next match when retrying a tower.
[*] Many texts were rewritten, significantly reducing grammar and spelling errors.
[*] Some parts of the credits can now be skipped forward (Different than Escape skip).
[*] Chest sequence is now 0.5s shorter.
[*] The [new] notification appeared in the themes menu for the last selectable box, even though this theme is not yet available for selection.
[*] Fixed 'Classick' achievement being unlocked at random after opening the classic mode menu.
[*] Fixed several UIs going out of bounds in ultrawide resolutions.
[*] Tooltip frame vertical position was not scaling relative to display height.
[*] "Potentially fixed" an error where the themes menu would loop itself after returning to the previous menu (Could not reproduce, but enforced a solution, let me know if anyone get stuck there again!)
[*] In-Match pause menu music volume slider was not working properly.
[*] Fixed a main menu text scaling issue (texts were larger than they should before hovering)
[*] Fixed several non-framerate independent animations.
[*] The Hangman minigame had two guessable words with spelling errors (This is honestly embarrassing)
[/list]

If you find any bug or glitches, or anything you would like to report, please, drop it by the bugs thread in the forums, hopefully it won't take me 6 years to fix this time ːsteamfacepalmː

Thanks for your patience, and sorry for so many years of neglect!
Emmanuel, (earrgames).

notes.title: Version 1.1.3 is out!
notes.content:
Hello again! It was about time for a small update, this version brings full compatibility for 4:3 aspect ratio and some minor graphical improvements. Also, there was a serious bug in the challenge mode which the level curses were not showing, now they can be played properly. 

As always, if you encounter any bug, please report it in the bug reporting thread.


[b]Versions 1.1.3 Log:[/b]
[list]
[*][Added] - Full resolution support for aspect ratios as low as 4:3. (Horizontal Black bars removed)
[*][Added] - Several game events will produce subtle particle effects on click.
[*][Changed] - Some animations and transitions has been slightly smoothed.
[*][Changed] - Small modifications to the Level/Match result screens were made.
[*][Changed] - A few grammar changes were done around.
[*][Fixed] - Curses were not showing in challenge mode levels.
[*][Fixed] - The lamps textures were not changing in classic, challenge and infinite mode to match the currect active theme.
[/list]

[i]Wishing you all the best.
Emmanuel (earrgames).[/i]

[/list] 

[b]As always, if you encounter any bug, please report it in the bug reporting thread.[/b]

[i]Wishing you all the best.
Emmanuel (earrgames).[/i]

notes.title: Version 1.1.0 is out!
notes.content:
Sorry for the absence, I was updating my old game Into the Gloom and took a bit more than expected... anyway, [b]The new Downbreak version 1.1.0 is out![/b] it features some changes to the campaign mode, two new items and a reworked tower-end reward system. Some graphics were improved too. And lastly, but not least important, now levels are 100% guaranteed to have a solution from top to bottom (Thanks Scott!).

[b]If you encounter any bug, please report on one of the pinned threads. Thanks![/b]


[b]V 1.1.0 Changes[/b]

[list]
[*][Added]  - Remaining level time now counts toward total level score.(25pts x Second)

[*][Changed] - Level solution path algorithm was improved; Now there will always be a way from top to bottom (including horizontal connections sometimes) which contains no bombs and which can't be obstructed by accident.
[*][Changed] - [b]Now after finishing a tower a prize can be chosen based on your unspent money and remaining item's value.[/b]
[*][Changed] - Campaign mode tower images were updated.
[*][Changed] - Level background (The area behind window holes) brightness was reduced a bit.
[*][Changed] - Minigames reward icon backlight animation was modified.

[*][Fixed] - Classick and Ultimatum achievements were not unlocking. 
[/list]

[i]Wishing you all the best,
Emmanuel (earrgames).[/i]

[Changed] - [b]Now after finishing a tower a prize can be chosen based on your unspent money and remaining item's value.[/b]

notes.title: V. 1.0.1 Update released.
notes.content:
[b]Hi there folks![/b] 

This first update brings many new configuration options for some of the suggestions so far, including (but not limited to) brightness control and disabling minigames events. It also now features in-game Changes log report and a notification system so I can let you know about important events.

[b]On Tuesday 17th[/b] we'll begin discussing relevant content changes and additions for the next big update in the Updates thread.

[b]V 1.0.1 Summary:[/b]
[list]
[*][Added] -In-game Changes Log panel, now detailed information about updates can be seen here.
[*][Added] -In-game notification system, now notifications about important news will be shown in the 'message' tab.
[*][Added] -Chording can now be performed with [Z] and the mouse wheel button [MMB].
[*][Added] -Brightness configuration option available.
[*][Added] -Master Volume configuration option available.
[*][Added] -Shake Intensity configuration option available.
[*][Added] -Disable/Enable ScanLines configuration option available.
[*][Added] -Disable/Enable Minigames configuration option available.
[*][Added] -Restore default Settings option available.
[*][Changed] -Minigames Skip button is now more visible.
[*][Changed] -Settings menu layout changed. Now divided by categories.
[*][Changed] -Basic tilesets speech bubble text was edited.
[*][Changed] -Classic mode level type selector arrow was replaced with text under the navigation icons.
[*][Fixed] -Unexpected behaviours could occur after deleting your current save file.
[*][Fixed] -Tutorial bug. If it was skipped then it could be seen in a normal level.
[/list]

Every time a change is made in the code is very probable that new bugs appear, if you spot any unusual behaviour please report it back ;)

[i]Wishing you all the best,
Emmanuel (earrgames).[/i]

[Added] -Chording can now be performed with [Z] and the mouse wheel button [MMB].
